slides.headline: Would you wear a $75 device that remembers every conversation?
Two new devices, under $100
slides.body: Bee Frontier wristband at $75, Bee Eclipse phone clip at $100 — first hardware since Amazon bought the company.

slides.headline: Turns talk into to-dos automatically
slides.body: Records conversations, summarizes them, creates calendar invites and action items — works with Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar.

slides.headline: Privacy claim: audio deleted instantly
slides.body: Company says raw audio is processed then erased; transcripts encrypted with keys only your device holds.

slides.headline: Real cost is $12 a month
slides.body: Free tier keeps 14 days of summaries; unlimited memory, Alexa shopping, and proactive to-dos require Bee Pro subscription.

slides.headline: Follow for AI that matters
slides.body: We explain new AI gear in plain language — no code, no hype.
